<!-- The card layout of SitemapFooter: the brand mark and word, then the link groups in one row, in a rounded card. -->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { MegaGroup } from "../blocks/mega-menu.types";

  export type FooterCardProps = {
    label: string;
    brand: string;
    groups: MegaGroup[];
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.svelte";
  import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

  let { label, brand, groups, landmarkLabel }: FooterCardProps = $props();
</script>

<Block tag="footer" class="py-8" data-layout="card" aria-label={landmarkLabel} data-slot="site-footer">
  <Container class={cn(cn("mx-auto w-full px-4", defaults.section.landing), "px-0")} data-slot="container">
    <Box
      class={cn("flex w-full flex-row items-start overflow-hidden bg-muted p-10", defaults.footer.card)}
      data-slot="footer-card"
    >
      <Group gap="4" align="center" class={cn("h-8 shrink-0", defaults.footer.brand)} data-slot="footer-brand">
        <Inline class="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded bg-foreground text-background">
          <LucideIcon name="hexagon" size={16} />
        </Inline>
        <Text size="base" weight="bold">
          {brand}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      {#if ((groups?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
        <NavBlock
          label={(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl("{0}, {1}", label, landmarkLabel)) : label)}
          class="min-w-0 flex-1"
        >
          <Group
            gap="0"
            align="start"
            class={cn("flex w-full flex-nowrap justify-between", defaults.footer.groups)}
            data-slot="footer-groups"
          >
            {#each groups as g (g.id)}
              <Stack gap="4" data-slot="group">
                <Text size="xs" weight="semibold" class="leading-5">
                  {g.title}
                </Text>
                <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0">
                  {#each g.links as item (item.id)}
                    <ListItem data-slot="links-row">
                      <MenuEntry href={item.href} class="text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
                        {item.name}
                      </MenuEntry>
                    </ListItem>
                  {/each}
                </List>
              </Stack>
            {/each}
          </Group>
        </NavBlock>
      {/if}
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
